# A verbatim copy of the Yahoo roster page STRUCTURE, with every
# Yahoo-generated number replaced by a placeholder.
#
# The structure is what the parser has to cope with and is not Yahoo's data -
# it is the shape of a web page. The projections, start percentages and scores
# that were originally here ARE Yahoo's data, and committing them to a public
# repository was a breach of obligation 1. They are placeholders now.
#
# Player names and slots are the manager's own roster, which is the same
# category as the league settings in src/league_bootstrap.py: his record of
# his own team.
